specificFindings: Victory, success, failure and loser statements are attributed to the cultural narrative under examination, not endorsed as universal judgements.
Rarely, relatively short-lived and sounds are preserved; lack of permanent joy is not equated with zero joy.
Tenure study predicted conditional emotions are distinguished from actual post-outcome interviews; obvious does not validate predictions.
Personal/interpersonal distinction follows close relationships versus achievements, without a guarantee for every person.
Tarantino and Jobs stories are book anecdotes used as examples; questions do not endorse lying or treat them as controlled happiness studies.
Memory and bandwidth are distinct; five displayed bars do not indicate the actual connection was good; eventually fixed targets memory only.
We do not know definitively limits the population-belief claim; saying is not evidence.
Pen-in-mouth task and enjoyment of cartoons are bounded experimental claims, not permanent mood therapy or guaranteed replication.
Nonetheless explicitly retains the mixed replication findings; media coverage and popular belief do not establish scientific efficacy.
Extravert experiment asks for behaviour, not permanent personality replacement.
Questions6,11,15,23,24 include the exact relevant antecedents needed for reference, paraphrase or logical relation; no extra source coverage is manufactured.
limitations: This is a batch of ongoing whole-book work, not all gaps completed.
Stable source candidate IDs remain distinct from finalized manual sentence boundaries.
